title: Enterprise Connectivity: primary service pricing
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs primary service pricing for service charge.

## Policy clause 1
This policy and its gate apply only to primary usage source classification; category-specific primary pricing overrides expressly stated in category-specific metering take priority.

## Policy clause 2
For source classification primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval.

## Policy clause 3
This gate is inapplicable to other source classification values.

## Policy clause 4
Use the tier recorded for each source service interval.

## Policy clause 5
Read standard unit price and regional multipliers for primary usage.

## Superseded scope 6
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Allocate generic monthly included volume across primary meter sources of the same holding and period in interval beginning then source-event reference order; prorate it by actual active UTC seconds divided by actual seconds in that UTC calendar month.

## Superseded scope 7
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Only the positive quantity beyond the remaining included allowance is charged.

## Policy clause 8
Allocate committed volume in that same order, splitting covered and uncovered primary quantities into distinguishable invoice lines.

## Policy clause 9
The holding commitment must cover the entire source interval to receive commitment reduction fractions; a boundary-crossing interval is split at the recorded commitment boundary.

## Superseded scope 10
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for corrected monthly transfer assessment; accepted-source pricing; net transfer invoice. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: For every quantity component choose the first applicable item in price precedence: an approved negotiated rate when negotiated pricing permission, then the committed fraction, then a recorded eligible promotion from campaign channels, then portfolio eligibility, then standard.

## Policy clause 11
The negotiated rate replaces the primary standard unit price before applying the region factor and receives no further discount.

## Policy clause 12
Promotions and reservations are mutually exclusive.

## Superseded scope 13
The following ordinary clause is no longer in force within the applicable assisted routes for net transfer invoice. It remains the ordinary basis outside those specifically defined routes. Retired within that scope: Round the final service subtotal using monetary decimal places and rounding convention after quantity multiplication, then apply tax treatment rules.

## Policy clause 14
No discount applies to taxes, license fees, standalone supplemental services or previously issued credits.

## Policy clause 15
Record selected pricing branch for each split quantity branch; it is part of the invoice-line identity.

## Policy clause 16
Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Evidence condition 1
For service charge, the authoritative system record must establish this condition before the action: For source classification primary, the source meter is posted and identifies the billed resource interval. This gate is inapplicable to other source classification values. The evidence consists of evidence-event identifier, status, interval beginning, interval ending. Correlate the same evidence-event identifier to the transaction being handled; a customer statement does not substitute for this record.

## Points of judgement
Do not apply a billing-period portfolio discount to a partial source interval before the full source period is closed.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the standard unit price, regional multipliers, generic monthly included volume, commitment reduction fractions, campaign reduction fraction, campaign channels, negotiated pricing permission, price precedence, monetary decimal places, rounding convention, billing calendar timezone, billing cycle used by this rule.
